content.title: Aftermath Emotion Tightening | Adult Support, Environmental Pressure, Tear Close
content.summary: A lighthouse keeper moves from supported aftermath to a beacon-lit tear close-up. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult support relationship anchors the opening. + Environmental pressure escalates in bounded steps. + Camera tightening never changes the causal situation. + A partial support cue bridges the companion leaving frame. + The final close view preserves visible emotional and environmental residue.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult lighthouse keeper seated on a flooded stone step while an adult medic supports his shoulder. Increase wind and spray in two steps while the medic's hand and the keeper's posture remain registered. Hold the keeper's wet eyes and salt-streaked face as beacon light crosses once and the storm residue continues.
